import pytest
from api_auth.tokens import Token, require_write_scope, InsufficientScopeError


def test_read_only_token_is_rejected():
    with pytest.raises(InsufficientScopeError):
        require_write_scope(Token(token_id="t2", scopes={"read"}))
explanation: Redundant assertion of the read-only rejection path. The existing suite already covers this, so the mutation is killed and this repair is not needed; included for completeness.
rationale: Asserts a read-only token is rejected, the behavior the existing suite already protects.
